Once we complete three rounds of each circuit, we then have a minute rest. If you have access to a selection of dumbbells, definitely keep those handy. But I would expect not to be able to lift as heavy as you typically would. There is only 10 second rests and your heart rate will be elevated for majority of this workout. Please ensure you're controlling the dumbbell at all times. This is not HIIT. This is not high intensity as fast as you can. This is quality reps trying to control the dumbbell whilst your heartbeat is elevated. I would just like to draw your attention to some of these exercises. The same applies with our dumbbell burpees. Please ensure when you're lifting the dumbbell, you're not grinding the back whilst lifting and lowering. Before you lift, ensure the heels are flat on the floor, your back is straight, you're looking forward. The same applies when you're descending, keep looking forward, flat back, chest open. Please ensure you spend at least five minutes warming up prior to beginning this workout. This is a full body workout. Some of the exercises today will definitely feel a little bit more challenging even if you are using light weights. For example, shoulder press, that will be coming after the decline push-ups which of course is targeting the shoulders. And also, whilst we work through that circuit, we have the squat depress.
